note: Real micro-tasks, paid in stock (the Nasdaq 100 by default) through Scrip's own organisation page. Every payment is on /@scrip, labelled as Scrip's. Edit this file to add or close a bounty.

bounties.title: Break the claim flow
bounties.how: Find a way to claim a first share that is not yours, or to take a sponsored position twice. A write-up with a signature; a failing test is better.

bounties.title: Translate one docs page
bounties.how: Any docs page, into any language you write natively. A pull request; the reason on your receipt is the page.

bounties.title: Thirty seconds on why you started saving
bounties.how: A phone video, you in it, your savings page public. Posted anywhere; send the link.

bounties.title: Design a stub variant
bounties.how: The stub at one of its five sizes, redrawn inside the design system: paper, ink, the perforation, units the largest thing. A file and a paragraph.
